text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A and D for gains felt good, but later buying more at higher prices showed me that trimming without a plan can mean giving up exposure and then chasing it back.","I should judge each holding by its outlook, valuation and role in the portfolio—not only by whether it is above my personal cost basis; gains and losses are not reasons by themselves to trade.","After two sharp monthly declines, doing nothing was not a strategy. I should set clear review and rebalancing rules in advance, while avoiding impulsive trades driven by short-term account moves."]}
